column1: # Member-level denominator for the OVERLAPPING index lifecycle vocabularies (#10433).
# The type ledger (workspace-index-lifecycle-propositions.v1.tsv) selects one owner
# per proposition family. This file dispositions every variant, variant field and
# struct field of the types whose names collide across those vocabularies, so a
# variant or field change cannot pass while the type declaration stays present.
# type_row must name a row in the type ledger, and must describe this member's own
# declaration. A member's disposition and successor follow that type row's role, so
# a member cannot claim authority its type does not hold or be handed to a
# different cutover owner. Members are extracted from source, so an added, removed
# or renamed variant or field fails the ratchet.
